shortDescription: Brazilian state-run oil firm Petrobras BMFBOVESPA:PETR3 said on Wednesday it is scrapping a discount of 0.44 real per liter on gasoline, while also increasing its prices to distributors by 0.19 real per liter.

children: said on Wednesday it is scrapping a discount of 0.44 real per liter on gasoline, while also increasing its prices to distributors by 0.19 real per liter.
In a statement, Petrobras said the effect on consumers and fuel distributors would fully offset by a tax cut announced by the government earlier in the day.
The government said it will cut federal taxes on gasoline imports and sales by 0.63 real per liter, replacing and expanding a previous cash subsidy of 0.44 real per liter.
The government also announced a diesel subsidy initially set at 1 real per liter, to be added to an existing subsidy.
Petrobras said it will await for the government to publish the legal acts regulating the new diesel subsidy before assessing and implementing it.

title: Petrobras removes discount and hikes prices on gasoline after Brazil tax cut
